Package org.ujorm.tools.common

Class StringUtils

java.lang.Object
org.ujorm.tools.common.StringUtils
public class StringUtils extends Object
Methods to reading an text resource to the String.

Usage

 try (Stream<String> stream = StringUtils.readLines(StringUtils.class,  "text", "dummy.txt")) {
     String[] result = stream.toArray(String[]::new);
     assertEquals("abc", result[0]);
 }

    • NARROW_NBSP

      public static final char NARROW_NBSP
      Non-breaking space used as a thousands separator.

      This character is defined by the ISO 80000-1 standard for separating groups of three digits. It ensures that large numbers remain on a single line while maintaining professional typographic spacing.

      See Also:

      @NotNull public static @NotNull String formatSeparator(@Nullable @Nullable Number number)
      Format number using THIN_NBSP for the thousand separator.

      10000 -> "10 000"
      1234.56 -> "1 234.56"
